timeline.summary: Kopran sets June 3, 2026 NCLT-ordered shareholder and creditor meetings to approve the merger of Kopran Laboratories.
Kopran Research Laboratories approved a ₹18.75 Cr rights issue for working capital and appointed Chandresh Gandhi as independent director.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹234.02 Cr (+35.8% YoY), net profit ₹18.87 Cr (+94.9% YoY).
Kopran released its FY26 investor presentation highlighting consolidated revenue of ₹681.42 Cr and progress on the Kopran Laboratories merger.

Kopran's equity shareholders, secured creditors and unsecured creditors approved the amalgamation of Kopran Laboratories into Kopran at NCLT-convened meetings on June 3, 2026; final NCLT sanction is pending.
EU GMP inspection of Khopoli formulation facility (Sep 18-23, 2026) concluded with no critical observations and one major observation.
